analysis.reason: 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. RSI는 과매도 구간 탈출 후 중립 구간 안착 시도 중. MACD 히스토그램은 음수 구간에서 개선세 보이며 바닥 다지기 신호. 5일 저가가 20일 저가보다 높아 Higher Low 패턴 형성. 거래량은 5일 평균 대비 0.30배로 위축되어 방향성 확인에 대한 신뢰도 낮음. 주봉 ADX 46.5로 뚜렷한 추세 유지하나, 일봉상으로는 변동성 축소 구간. 240,000원 지지선, 370,000원 저항선 사이 횡보 구간 진입. 매수/매도 어느 한쪽으로 확신 주기 어려움.
analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive trading days. RSI is attempting to settle in neutral territory after exiting oversold conditions. MACD histogram shows improvement in negative territory, signaling bottoming action. A higher low pattern is forming as the 5-day low (202000 KRW) is above the 20-day low (189200 KRW). Trading volume is subdued at 0.30x the 5-day average, reducing confidence in directional conviction. Weekly ADX at 46.5 indicates a clear trend, but daily price action is in a consolidation phase. The price is trading between the 240,000 KRW support and 370,000 KRW resistance levels. Difficulty in establishing strong conviction for either a buy or sell action.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (248,750 KRW) above SMA5 (239,550 KRW), below SMA20 (252,788 KRW), and below SMA50 (296,548 KRW) — indicating short-term weakness and entry into medium-term downtrend.
· Below SMA100 (259,239 KRW) and above SMA200 (194,951 KRW) — suggesting mixed long-term trend.
· 52-week position (59.0%) — trading near the historical midpoint.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (33.8 → 46.6) — attempting to enter neutral territory after exiting oversold conditions.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-5410.1222 → 1145.7955) — improving in negative territory, signaling bottoming action.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near middle band at 252,788 KRW) — trading sideways near the middle band, with a band width of 33.90% indicating reduced volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support level (240,000 KRW) — based on Pivot Point (PP 245,983 KRW) and SMA5 (239,550 KRW).
· Swing resistance level (370,000 KRW) — adjacent to the 52-week high (374,500 KRW).
· 5-day high (267,000 KRW)/low (202,000 KRW), 20-day high (300,000 KRW)/low (189,200 KRW) — 5-day low > 20-day low suggests Higher Low pattern formation.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.30x) — subdued compared to the 5-day average, indicating low confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation Zone) — trading sideways between the 240,000 KRW support and 370,000 KRW resistance; maintaining a wait-and-see approach until directional conviction is established.
